test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What should come in the place of blank number 5?
solution: The correct answer is '**Inspire**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The concluding sentence sums up the emotional impact of the story: "Life is full of unexpected encounters, each one with the power to (5)_________ us..." • "**Inspire**" (प्रेरित करना) means to fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially something creative or positive. This is the central theme of the passage—a chance meeting that leaves a lasting, positive impression. • The narrator has already stated they left the park "**inspired**" in the previous sentence. Using the verb form "inspire" here reinforces the main takeaway of the narrative. • "**Teach**" (Option 1) is a factual outcome, but the tone of the passage is more emotional and transformative than merely educational. • "**Challenge**" (Option 2) means to test one's abilities or beliefs. While the narrator's perspective changed, the overall "vibe" of the encounter was one of encouragement and shared humanity. • "**Overwhelm**" (Option 4) usually implies being defeated or crushed by a feeling, which is too intense and potentially negative for this uplifting conclusion. Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'. Complete Passage Segment: *I was strolling through the park one night when I saw a man sitting by himself on a bench. He was dressed in frayed clothes, and his face was creased with (1)worry__ He looked lost in thought, gazing at the ground as if trying to find answers. I paused for a moment before going over to talk to him. When I said hello, he looked up and smiled weakly. He began talking to me about his life, including his triumphs and setbacks, love and grief. His stories were so enlightening, and his perspective (2)__enlightened__ He got to his feet as the sun began to set and thanked me for the chance to hear about his experiences. "Sometimes, all we need is someone to hear us," he stated. His words lingered in my mind, bringing to mind the (3)__power__ of human connection. That night, I left the park humbled and (4)__inspired__. Life is full of unexpected encounters, each one with the power to (5)__inspire__ us in ways that we never thought possible.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Thematic Consistency:** In competitive English sections, the conclusion of a story usually mirrors the emotions established in the "climax" or "turning point." Since the conversation was "enlightening," the result is "inspiration." • **Human Connection:** The passage highlights the psychological importance of being heard, a theme often found in ethics-based reading comprehension sets. • **Grammar Tip:** When a word appears as an adjective in one sentence (inspired), it is very common for the corresponding verb (inspire) to appear in the summary or concluding statement of the same passage. 40:T906,
